links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated versus OrthoInfo patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT average grade level 8.7, OpenEvidence 10.1, OrthoInfo 10.8, all above the 6th-grade target despite a prompt requesting sixth-grade level.
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated PEMs had the lowest average reading grade level (8.7) compared to OrthoInfo (10.8) and Open Evidence (10.1).

links.outcome: Reading level of patient education materials versus recommended 6th-grade level
links.effect: OrthoInfo PEMs averaged 10.8 grade level; AI outputs 8.7 (ChatGPT) and 10.1 (OpenEvidence), all above 6th-grade recommendation.
links.quote: While OrthoInfo remains the gold standard in content accuracy and completeness, it falls short of national readability guidelines.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of AI-generated pediatric orthopaedic PEMs rated by blinded surgeons
links.effect: Total accuracy: OrthoInfo 6.95, ChatGPT 6.15, OpenEvidence 3.25; total completeness: OrthoInfo 6.98, ChatGPT 5.90, OpenEvidence 3.05.
links.quote: OrthoInfo PEMs were rated highest for accuracy and completeness (total accuracy: 6.95; total completeness: 6.98), compared to Chat GPT (total accuracy: 6.15; total completeness: 5.90) and Open Evidence (total accuracy: 3.25; total completeness: 3.05), but ChatGPT approached OrthoInfo in several subdomains, including treatment descriptions, timeline, and follow-up recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to rewrite patient education materials at a sixth-grade reading level

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT and OpenEvidence to generate pediatric orthopaedic patient education materials at a target reading level and evaluates readability, accuracy, and completeness via expert raters, without testing an organizational deployment practice.
